FilePosition.description: How far into its file a print had got, and when that was read.

bytes.description: The byte the printer had read the file up to.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, when it was known.

PlannedChange.description:
One stop the print's own G-code plans: an `M600` colour change or an
`M601` pause, where the firmware waits for a person.

color.description:
The colour loaded at it, as `#RRGGBB` in upper case, from the
`;COLOR_CHANGE,T<n>,#RRGGBB` line just before its `M600`; null for an
`M601`, and for an `M600` with no such line.

index.description: Its place among the file's changes, counting from 0 in file order.

kind.description: What it stops the print for.

layer.description:
The first layer printed after it, counting the first as 1: the layer
whose `;Z:` is the change's height.

offset_bytes.description: The byte offset of the first byte of its `M600` or `M601` line.

PlannedChangeKind.description: What a planned change stops the print for.

oneOf.description: An `M600`: the firmware stops so a person can load the next colour.
An `M601`: the firmware pauses until a person resumes it.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
A print carried on from a planned change it was waiting at: its file
position moved past the change. Recorded once per change reached, and the
check it prompts runs at once.

change.description: The change the print carried on from.

position.description: Where the job stood when it was found to have carried on.

previous_color.description:
The colour of the stretch before it, as `#RRGGBB`; null when the file
names none.

waited_s.description: How long the print waited at it, in whole seconds.

title: FilamentChangePlannedResumedPayload
